meta.descriptionAccommodations: Discover the rooms and suites at Pousada Recanto do Park, in Penha, Brazil.

hero.title: Your getaway, steps from the magic
hero.subtitle: Just minutes from Beto Carrero World and the most beautiful beaches on the Santa Catarina coast.

about.title: Rest and adventure, side by side
about.body: Pousada Recanto do Park was made to be the perfect starting point for your Beto Carrero World and Penha beach getaway. A family-friendly atmosphere, comfort in every detail, and the most convenient location in the area.

location.title: Between the park and the sea
location.parkDescription: Latin America's largest theme park, right around the corner.
location.beachDescription: Armação, Gravatá and Prainha beaches waiting for you.

accommodationsPreview.title: Rooms for every kind of trip

hero.title: Comfort designed for your stay
hero.subtitle: From cozy doubles to family suites: find the perfect space for your trip.

detail.galleryHint: Tap the photo to zoom in

standardCasal.name: Standard Double
standardCasal.description: A cozy room for couples, with a queen bed, air conditioning and garden views.
standardCasal.longDescription: Designed for couples, the Standard Double combines comfort and simplicity: a queen bed, air conditioning, quality linens and garden views. Ideal for a calm base between park days and beach days.

standardFamilia.name: Standard Family
standardFamilia.description: Room for up to 4 guests, ideal for small families visiting the park.
standardFamilia.longDescription: A room built for the whole family: space for up to 4 guests, a flexible bed setup, and everything you need to rest between a day at the park and a day at the beach.

superiorVistaJardim.name: Superior Garden View
superiorVistaJardim.description: A larger room with a private balcony overlooking the pousada's green area.
superiorVistaJardim.longDescription: Roomier than the Standard, the Superior Garden View has a private balcony overlooking the pousada's green area. The perfect spot for a slow breakfast before heading out for the day.

suiteMaster.name: Master Suite
suiteMaster.description: Our most complete room, with a whirlpool tub and mini fridge.
suiteMaster.longDescription: Our most complete room: a whirlpool tub, mini fridge, and the largest space in the whole pousada. For anyone who wants the stay itself to be part of the trip.

quartoGrupo.name: Group Room
quartoGrupo.description: Comfortable bunk beds for up to 6 guests, perfect for the whole crew.
quartoGrupo.longDescription: Built for groups and big families: comfortable bunk beds for up to 6 guests, plenty of room for luggage, and everything close by, perfect for a crew visiting the park and the beach together.

t2.name: João and family
